main_text.p: sanctificatorum salus. Psal. 84. 8. Ibunt de virtute ad virtutem, donec conspiciatur quisque eorum ante Deum in Tzijone. Phil. 4, 14.

XIX. Pro praxi; 1. Ne adversus praeclarum illud Dei & Christi nos conservantis beneficium profana ingratitudine peccemus: 2 Cor. 7, 1. Sed serio expendamus, quae poenae maneant sanctimoniae expertes: Hebr. XII, 14, 16. Matth. VII, 23. XXV, 41. & quomodo ipsi sanctificati, ubi officia sua negligunt, & in graviora peccata labuntur, saepius affligantur graviter; tum animo, variis terroribus: Psal. 6, 4. tum corpore, morbis & cruciatibus: Levit. 26. 16. Psal. 6, 2, 3. XXXVIII, 2, 3, 4. 1 Cor. XI, 31, 32. tum denique bonis externis, per eorum jacturam: Levit. XXVI, 16, 17. Hos. 2, 8. Ista nos a defectione absterreant, & in veram sanctitatis viam redigant: Hos. 2, 13. VI, 1. 1 Cor. XI, 32. Hebr. 12, 10, -14.

2. Sincerum esto, ac perpetuum, sub hac Dei & Servatoris nostri gratia, studium Ipsi parendi ac placendi: Rom. 12, 1. 2 Thess. 2, 13. Sic methodum salutis obtinendae, Decreto Dei constitutam, Euangelio nobis revelatam, variisque Promissionibus confirmatam, observemus sedulo & constanter: Rom. VIII, 28. -. 1 Tim. IV, 7. -10. Hebr. X, 35, 36. Matth. XXIV, 13.
3. Agnoscamus ordinariam illam methodum salutis applicandae: & necessitatem atque insignem utilitatem incrementi spiritualis: Eph. 4, 16. Psal. 84, 8. Phil. 3, 14.

4. Exploremus nos ipsos quoufque modo perveneri-mus; & quae sint nostrae vires spirituales: Zeph. 2, 1. 1 Cor. XI, 28. Profectui & corroborationi studeamus sedulo: Iof. I, 6, 7, 9. adhibitis potissimum mediis, quae indicata sunt sup. th. 17.

page.notes: Catchword-like line "CAP." at lower right is treated as the closing word of the page. Some words in the scan are blurred; the Greek in "Tzijone" (Sion) is transliterated as printed in the scan and may be doubtful. Right-hand page text is not present; only one printed page.
